run_finetuner_cli: run the FineTuner CLI to fine-tune a dynamics model using agent-collected trajectories and save results
create_FineTuner: create a FineTuner instance that loads a dynamics model, agent, and replay buffer from directories
run_FineTuner_run: run the FineTuner to collect trajectories, train the dynamics model, and save losses and buffers

summarize_LOG_FORMAT: summarize the LOG_FORMAT list that defines epoch, loss, and validation score logging columns
